subject: general
question: The Ayush Ministry has collaborated with the UK’s London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (LSHTM) to conduct a study on ______ for promoting recovery from COVID - 19.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashwagandha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ayush Ministry has collaborated with the UK's London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (LSHTM) to conduct a study on **Ashwagandha** for promoting recovery from COVID-19.
 
• **Ashwagandha** is a traditional herb known for its potential health benefits, including stress reduction, improved energy levels, and enhanced immunity.
 
• This study aims to scientifically validate the efficacy of Ashwagandha in aiding the recovery process of COVID-19 patients.
 
• Ashwagandha is widely used in Ayurvedic medicine and is considered an adaptogen, helping the body to manage stress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ashwagandha** (Withania somnifera) is also known as Indian ginseng or winter cherry.
 
• It has been used in traditional Indian medicine for over 3,000 years.
 
• The herb is believed to offer numerous benefits, such as reducing anxiety and stress, boosting brain function, and combating depression.
 
• Clinical trials and research are ongoing to explore its full potential and therapeutic uses.
